mapper.select: SELECT a.uuid, a.name, a.handler, a.begin_time, a.end_time, a.cron, a.is_active, a.need_audit, a.source_server_id, d.prop_name, d.prop_value, d.id as prop_id FROM schedule_job a LEFT JOIN schedule_job_prop d ON a.uuid = d.job_uuid WHERE a.uuid = #{uuid}

SELECT `uuid`, `name`, `handler`, `begin_time` AS beginTime, `end_time` AS endTime, `cron`, `is_active` AS isActive, `need_audit` AS needAudit, `source_server_id` AS sourceServerId FROM `schedule_job` WHERE `uuid` = #{value}

SELECT `job_name` as jobName, `job_group` as jobGroup, `handler`, `last_fire_time` as lastFireTime, `last_finish_time` as lastFinishTime, `next_fire_time` as nextFireTime, `exec_count` as execCount FROM `schedule_job_status` WHERE `job_name` = #{jobName} AND `job_group` = #{jobGroup}

SELECT a.`uuid`, a.`name`, a.`handler`, a.`begin_time`, a.`end_time`, a.`cron`, a.`is_active`, a.`need_audit`, a.`source_server_id`, d.prop_name, d.prop_value, d.id as prop_id FROM `schedule_job` a LEFT JOIN schedule_job_prop d ON a.uuid = d.job_uuid WHERE `handler` = #{value}

choose.otherwise: and not exists (select 1 from schedule_job sj_filter where sj_filter.uuid = job_uuid)

where.if: and ( start_time >= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{startTimeRange[0]}) and start_time <= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{startTimeRange[1]}) )

mapper.select:
SELECT a.id, a.`job_uuid` AS jobUuid, a.`start_time` AS startTime, a.`end_time` AS endTime, a.`status`, a.server_id AS serverId, a.content_hash AS contentHash, a.`cron`, a.`next_fire_time` AS nextFireTime, COALESCE(sjs.job_group, sjl.job_group) AS jobGroupName, COALESCE(sjs.handler, sjl.job_handler, sj.handler) AS jobHandler FROM `schedule_job_audit` a LEFT JOIN `schedule_job` sj ON a.job_uuid = sj.uuid LEFT JOIN ( SELECT job_name, MIN(job_group) AS job_group, MIN(handler) AS handler FROM schedule_job_status GROUP BY job_name ) sjs ON a.job_uuid = sjs.job_name LEFT JOIN ( SELECT job_name, MIN(job_group) AS job_group, MIN(job_handler) AS job_handler FROM schedule_job_lock GROUP BY job_name ) sjl ON a.job_uuid = sjl.job_name
ORDER BY a.`id` DESC LIMIT #{startNum}, #{pageSize}

SELECT `id`, `job_uuid` AS jobUuid, `start_time` AS startTime, `end_time` AS endTime, `content_hash` AS contentHash, b.`content`, `status`, `server_id` AS serverId, `cron`, `next_fire_time` AS nextFireTime FROM `schedule_job_audit` a LEFT JOIN `schedule_job_audit_detail` b ON a.content_hash = b.hash WHERE id = #{value}

SELECT `id`, `job_uuid` AS jobUuid, `start_time` AS startTime, `end_time` AS endTime, `content_hash` AS contentHash, b.`content`, `status`, `server_id` AS serverId, `cron`, `next_fire_time` AS nextFireTime FROM `schedule_job_audit` a LEFT JOIN `schedule_job_audit_detail` b ON a.content_hash = b.hash WHERE job_uuid = #{value}

SELECT `job_name` as jobName, `job_group` as jobGroup, `job_handler` as jobHandler, `lock`, `server_id` as serverId FROM `schedule_job_lock` WHERE job_name = #{jobName} AND job_group = #{jobGroup} FOR UPDATE
SELECT `job_name` as jobName, `job_group` as jobGroup, `job_handler` as jobHandler, `lock`, `server_id` as serverId FROM `schedule_job_lock` WHERE server_id = #{value}

SELECT `job_name` AS jobName, `job_group` AS jobGroup, `server_id` AS serverId, `server_start_time` AS serverStartTime FROM `schedule_job_load` WHERE `job_name` = #{jobName} AND `job_group` = #{jobGroup}
mapper.update: UPDATE schedule_job SET name = #{name}, begin_time = #{beginTime}, end_time = #{endTime}, cron = #{cron}, is_active = #{isActive}, need_audit = #{needAudit}, source_server_id = IFNULL(source_server_id, #{sourceServerId}) WHERE uuid = #{uuid}

UPDATE schedule_job_status SET next_fire_time = #{nextFireTime}, last_finish_time = #{lastFinishTime}, last_fire_time = #{lastFireTime}, exec_count = #{execCount}, `lcd` = NOW() WHERE job_name = #{jobName} AND job_group = #{jobGroup}
mapper.insert: insert into schedule_job_data (job_uuid, data_name, data_value) values (#{jobUuid}, #{name}, #{value}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE data_value = #{value}
INSERT IGNORE INTO schedule_job_audit_detail (hash, content) values (#{hash}, #{content,typeHandler=CompressHandler})
INSERT schedule_job_prop (job_uuid, prop_name, prop_value) VALUES (#{jobUuid}, #{name}, #{value, typeHandler=CompressHandler})
INSERT INTO schedule_job_audit (id, job_uuid, start_time, status, server_id, cron, next_fire_time) VALUES (#{id}, #{jobUuid}, now(3), #{status}, #{serverId}, #{cron}, #{nextFireTime})

INSERT INTO `schedule_job_load` ( `job_name`, `job_group`, `server_id`, `server_start_time` ) VALUES ( #{jobName}, #{jobGroup}, #{serverId}, #{serverStartTime} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE `server_start_time` = #{serverStartTime}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM schedule_job_status WHERE next_fire_time < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
delete from schedule_job_audit where end_time < DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL #{value} DAY)
delete a FROM schedule_job_audit_detail a LEFT JOIN schedule_job_audit b ON a.`hash` = b.`content_hash` WHERE b.`content_hash` IS NULL
